products.name: Netskope Client Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A Netskope client troubleshooting and diagnostics toolkit — structured runbooks for steering, auth, performance, and certificate failures, plus PowerShell/Python diagnostics that collect the right state and point to the root cause. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Fix Netskope client issues fast — with a real diagnostics toolkit, not guesswork

When the Netskope client misbehaves — traffic not steering, auth loops, slow browsing, an app broken behind the proxy — the help desk burns hours guessing. This solution gives your team a Netskope client troubleshooting and diagnostics toolkit: structured runbooks for the common failure classes (steering, authentication, performance, certificate/decryption) plus PowerShell/Python diagnostics that collect the right logs and state and point to the root cause.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Netskope client architecture from a support view, the common failure classes (steering, auth, performance, certificate/decryption), and the diagnose-then-resolve model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (the Netskope client on endpoints, log access, Intune for at-scale collection, admin access for verification) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the diagnostics toolkit, build the per-failure-class runbooks, wire log/state collection, validate against known issues, then pilot with the help desk, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — client-state discovery, steering/auth/connectivity validation, a client-health and issue report, safe remediation (restart/repair/re-enroll client with -WhatIf), and a diagnostics-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Netskope client issues resolved fast — failure-class runbooks and diagnostics that collect the right state and point to root cause — so the help desk stops guessing, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSDIAG-Discovery.ps1 — Netskope client state, services, processes, and certificate posture
    • NSDIAG-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation: restart / repair / re-enroll the Netskope client
    • NSDIAG-Report.ps1 — client-health and device-context report (Microsoft Graph)
    • NSDIAG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/confirm the diagnostics scope group (Microsoft Graph)
    • NSDIAG-Validation.ps1 — connectivity, steering, and auth-state checks for the Netskope client

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
